title: Apply modern gradient styling to dashboard

requirements.text: Apply modern color gradients to dashboard elements including FactorMarker cards, IntermittentFastingPanel, and NutritionPanel while preserving the existing DNA helix background (AnimatedHelixBackground.tsx)

quotes: Lass uns das Dashboard noch moderner gestalten. Moderne Farbverläufe. Der Hintergrund bleibt unverändert

acceptanceCriteria: FactorMarker cards display modern gradient backgrounds instead of solid colors
IntermittentFastingPanel uses gradient styling for visual appeal
DNA helix background (AnimatedHelixBackground.tsx) remains completely unchanged
Gradients use colors from the existing OKLCH color system (golden/amber, sage/earth tones)
Dark mode gradients remain visually cohesive with the DNA helix theme

requirements.text: Ensure gradient styling maintains readability and accessibility with sufficient contrast for text overlays and interactive elements
acceptanceCriteria: Text remains readable against gradient backgrounds in both light and dark modes
Interactive elements (buttons, inputs) maintain clear visual states on gradient backgrounds
Hover and active states work effectively with gradient styling

constraints: Do not modify AnimatedHelixBackground.tsx or any DNA helix background components
Use only colors from the existing OKLCH color system defined in index.css and tailwind.config.js
nonGoals: Changing the DNA helix background design
Modifying color palette or adding new color variables
Restructuring dashboard layout or component hierarchy
Adding new dashboard panels or features
